mapper.sql: task_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, requested_model_id, model_id, status, trace_id, error_code, error_message, created_time, deadline_at, started_time, finished_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_task ( task_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, requested_model_id, model_id, status, created_time, deadline_at ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{requestedModelId}, #{modelId}, 'QUEUED', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{timeoutSeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) )
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_task SET status = 'RUNNING', started_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'QUEUED' AND

UPDATE agent_task SET status = 'REJECTED', error_code = 'TASK_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED', error_message = '任务执行器暂时无法接收请求，请稍后重试', finished_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'QUEUED' AND

UPDATE agent_task SET status = #{status}, trace_id = #{traceId}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND #{status} IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED') AND

UPDATE agent_task SET status = 'TIMED_OUT', error_code = 'TASK_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED', error_message = '任务超过整体截止时间', finished_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND deadline_at IS NOT NULL AND deadline_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)

UPDATE agent_task SET status = 'TIMED_OUT', error_code = 'TASK_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED', error_message = '任务超过整体截止时间', finished_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND deadline_at IS NOT NULL AND deadline_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY deadline_at, task_id LIMIT 100
UPDATE agent_task SET trace_id = #{traceId} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'TIMED_OUT' AND started_time IS NOT NULL AND trace_id IS NULL AND #{traceId} IS NOT NULL AND #{traceId} <> ''

UPDATE agent_task SET status = CASE WHEN deadline_at IS NOT NULL AND deadline_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) THEN 'TIMED_OUT' ELSE 'FAILED' END, error_code = CASE WHEN deadline_at IS NOT NULL AND deadline_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) THEN 'TASK_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED' ELSE 'TASK_PROCESS_RESTARTED' END, error_message = CASE WHEN deadline_at IS NOT NULL AND deadline_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) THEN '任务超过整体截止时间' ELSE '服务启动时发现遗留未完成任务，本地执行已中断，未自动重试' END, finished_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
